title: Bali Family EV Road Trip Loop: Ubud → Seminyak → Uluwatu Guide 2026
subtitle: A 5-day electric family adventure through Bali's rice terraces, beaches, and cliff temples with zero charging anxiety

route.charger: Beachwalk Mall (60kW) or hotel overnight AC charging
route.kidActivities: Seminyak Beach sunset, Double Six Beach playground, Finns Recreation Club

route.charger: Trans Studio Mall Denpasar (90kW) or Ubud Palace area
route.kidActivities: Ubud Monkey Forest, Tegalalang Rice Terraces, Bali Bird Park

route.charger: Go-Ion Sanur (60kW) or Sanur Beach hotel
route.kidActivities: Bali Safari & Marine Park, Sanur Beach calm waters, Ubud Art Market (morning)

route.charger: Bali Collection Nusa Dua (90kW) or Uluwatu hotel
route.kidActivities: Uluwatu Temple and Kecak dance, Pandawa Beach caves, GWK Cultural Park

route.charger: Ion Ciputra World (final charge before return)
route.kidActivities: Waterbom Bali water park (on the way to airport), Jimbaran Bay seafood lunch

bestFor: Families visiting Bali for the first time who want to see the island without renting a scooter or hiring a driver
tips: Rent a family-friendly EV from Go-Ion Bali (BYD Dolphin starts at IDR 600k/day) — they deliver to the airport
Bali traffic is real — allow 2x Google Maps time between Ubud and Seminyak
Many villas now offer wall outlet (230V) overnight charging — bring your Type 2 cable
Uluwatu's Kecak fire dance show is at sunset — kids under 6 may find the fire scary, prepare them in advance
Waterbom Bali is on the way from Uluwatu to the airport — perfect final-day activity before your flight
Download the Go-Ion app for live charger availability — it's the most reliable network on the island
Best time: April-October (dry season). Avoid January-February when monsoon rains flood narrow Balinese roads
